name: sis-bombastic
description: Sistema local de administración - Bombastic Dreamers

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.stop: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001,5173 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.dev: npm run stop && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
